referenceFunction.generalComment: Electricity imports in this dataset are representing physical electricity imports as far as such data is available from statistical data sources, in case of data gaps supplemented by trade flow information that also includes physical amounts. Unrealistic values were removed where present. The imported electricity is assumed to reflect the corresponding foreign consumption mix. UUID: f7d8ed81-9591-33c9-ba24-a2b63bc86259
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Included are the shares of supply mixes for the corresponding trade partners. Not included are transformation, transport or distribution losses except those already covered in the supply mixes.
referenceFunction.name: Electricity imports

geography.text: Data apply to utilities and auto-producers.

technology.text: No technology description is provided because the dataset just describes the power plant portfolio of the respective country using current average technology per energy carrier.
